ActorTalk: Hey, did you hear? The Gray Raven Commandant is giving an alumni speech soon.
Of course I heard! The Gray Raven Commandant has always been my role model!
Commandant!
We really are on the same wavelength!
I thought we agreed to meet here?
We did! But I was just thinking about you, and then you appeared! That's what I call being on the same wavelength.
While I was waiting, I saw all these students walking by in the coolest uniforms. Way sharper than anything in Golden Age docs. So this is what school life is like, huh?
Commandant, did you ever go to school festivals or join any clubs? Oh, and the docs mentioned class trips!
You might be disappointed. It wasn't all that exciting.
Would surface combat drills count as something similar?
Any story with you in it could never disappoint me!
Sounds a lot like what we do every day! So in a way, I've already experienced part of the F.O.S. curriculum, right?
Are you that curious about F.O.S.?
It's not just F.O.S. I'm curious about. I'm even more interested in you, Commandant.
It's natural to want to learn about the sides of someone you care about, right?
That's the real reason I came to F.O.S. today.
In that case, want to explore the campus with me?
Yes! I was hoping you'd say that! Hmm... where should we start?
We're already at the Collaborative Teaching Center. Let's start here.
Ready when you are!
